say:2:1030408201:1.text: Yes dear, that woman in black brought back by the soldiers is definitely an evil witch.
say:2:1030408201:1.source_cn: 没错，士兵们带回的那个黑衣女人，就是魔女。

say:3:1030408202:1.text: Didn't you notice? They tied her hands to prevent her from casting spells and harming others.
say:3:1030408202:1.source_cn: 你没注意到吗？士兵们把她的手捆起来了，那就是为了防止她...

say:4:1030408203:1.text: I heard she caused a fire in Ryeham... What a heinous woman.
say:4:1030408203:1.source_cn: 听说金穗村的大火就是她引发的，真是作孽啊……

say:5:1030408204:1.text: But... she's so pretty! She doesn't look like a bad person!
say:5:1030408204:1.source_cn: 可是，魔女姐姐那么漂亮，我不觉得她像坏人！

say:6:1030408205:1.text: You, child, are so easily swayed by appearances!
say:6:1030408205:1.source_cn: 你这孩子，怎么这么容易就被外表迷惑了！

say:7:1030408206:1.text: Let me tell you, many people put on a facade just to trick innocent children like you.
say:7:1030408206:1.source_cn: 很多虚伪之人，都会披上一层道貌岸然的伪装，为的就是欺骗...

say:8:1030408207:1.text: But mommy, I think you're sort of pretty too. So... are you also tricking me?
say:8:1030408207:1.source_cn: 可我觉得，您也挺漂亮的，难道……您也是在骗我？

say:9:1030408208:1.text: Oho? Just "sort of" pretty? Come on home, I think we need to work on your vocabulary!
say:9:1030408208:1.source_cn: 噢？仅仅是“挺漂亮”吗？来，我带你回去洗洗眼睛。
